name: completeness_conciseness
description: subquery 하나를 보여주고 관련 atomic fact를 모두 고른 뒤, fact들이 subquery를 커버하는지 판단 (사수 Task 1)

questions.prompt: Which statements are relevant to this sub-question (give part or all of its answer)?
questions.none_option: None of the statements is relevant

questions.prompt: Taken together, do the statements fully answer this sub-question?

instructions.title: Which statements answer the sub-question, and is it fully answered?
instructions.summary: For one sub-question, mark which atomic statements are relevant to it and whether they fully answer it.
instructions.background: A question was split into sub-questions, and a QA system's answer was split into short atomic statements. We measure whether the answer is complete (every sub-question answered) and concise (no statements that answer nothing).
definitions: One part of the original question. Often identical to it when the question was not split.
One short claim taken from the system's answer.
The statement gives part or all of the answer to this sub-question. Background that does not answer it is not relevant.
The relevant statements together fully answer the sub-question. If a key piece is missing choose Not covered.
howto: Read the original question and the sub-question.
Judge from the statements only; do not check whether they are true.
instructions.tip: A sub-question can be Not covered even if some statements are relevant.
